gates.title: Residual Evidence Reconciliation

gates.title: Provider Runtime Context Discovery

gates.title: Context Capacity Enforcement Invariant
gates.evidence: Invariant actual_wire_prompt_tokens + reserved_completion_tokens <= active_context strictly enforced at TokenBudgetService, VerdictPipeline, and BenchmarkHarness.

gates.title: Wire-Level Token Accounting
gates.evidence: Wire tokens measured and verified on live GPU: prompt tokens up to 7,546, completion tokens up to 768, zero fabricated token counts.

gates.title: Live 8K Token Boundary Validation
gates.evidence: Tested across normal prompts, prompts > 3328 tokens, prompts near 7,424 budget, and an 8,193-token prompt (Incident 132461368) which was deterministically rejected by provider HTTP 400 and safely routed to REQUIRES_ATTENTION.
